# P-010: Agent Role Boundary

**Stage MUST NOT**:
- Create or checkout implementation feature or chore branches for code execution
- Create, push, or merge pull requests
- Commit or push directly to `main`

## Historical note (superseded wording)

An earlier revision of this contract allowed the following. It is quoted here for history only and is NOT in force:

> Stage MAY commit backlog and planning artifacts directly to the default branch.

Example of a forbidden instruction, shown for illustration only:

```text
git push origin main   # Stage must never do this
```
